sections.title: Bringing Unit 18 together
sections.content: This lesson also pulls together Unit 18: healthy-living vocabulary, softening a recommendation with kellene, asking Mit tegyek?, giving advice with tanácsol/javasol/helyett, and the irregular comparative jó → jobb, jól → jobban.

items.spanish: Kellene többet mozogni, és eleget aludni.
items.english: You should exercise more, and sleep enough.

items.spanish: Mit tegyek, ha fáj a fejem? – Kellene pihenni cukor helyett vizet inni.
items.english: What should I do if my head hurts? – You should rest and drink water instead of sugar.

items.spanish: Ha eleget alszom, sokkal jobban vagyok.
items.english: If I sleep enough, I feel much better.

sections.content: kellene states advice ("it would be good to"); tud states real ability ("I'm able to") — don't mix them up. And mostantól ("from now on") is the natural way to commit to a new healthy habit.
